about: Artwork the owner has asked for that no tool can find: changes to existing pictures, or pictures the game's data does not name. npm run art:worklist puts every open request at the top of docs/ART-WORKLIST.md as work. Close one by setting "done" to the commit that delivered it.

requests.what: Draw the game's name, POOL OF RADIANCE, as its own picture: a 1280 by 800 PNG with a transparent background, the lettering placed to sit over the harbour title art (upgrades/harbor-title.png), in the style of the publisher screen's lettering (upgrades/publisher-splash.png). Save it as upgrades/title-name.png and add "scene:title-name": "title-name.png" to "assets" in upgrades/manifest.json. The page already fades it in over the title art in Enhanced (tools/play.js, showTitleName); leave upgrades/harbor-title.png as it is.
requests.asked: The owner, 2026-11-22: "I like that new title screen except it doesn't actually have the title on it." Then: "I like the idea of having the title fade in over the harbor ... keep them as separate pictures ... and we can fade one into the other."

requests.what: Draw SPECIAL EDITION as its own picture: a 1280 by 800 PNG with a transparent background, lettered to sit under the game's name (scene:title-name) over the harbour title art, in the same style. Save it as upgrades/title-edition.png and add "scene:title-edition": "title-edition.png" to "assets" in upgrades/manifest.json. The page fades it in after the name (tools/play.js, showTitleName).
requests.asked: The owner, 2026-11-22: "We want a second title after the first one that says special edition."

requests.what: The combat icon editor's Head goes from 0 to 13 (GAME.OVR slice 16 at 3bd4 to 3c0d) and the small icon's heads are CHEAD.DAX blocks 0 to 13, but Enhanced has art for small heads 0 to 10 only: for heads 11, 12 and 13 there is no combat:party key at all, so a character given one of them has no Enhanced icon, in the editor or in a fight. Draw, for each of CHEAD.DAX blocks 11, 12 and 13 as the head, each of the 32 small CBODY.DAX blocks 0 to 31 as weapon and body, the ready pose (key combat:party:<head>:<body>) and the strike pose (combat:party:<head>:<body + 128>), in the style of the existing small icons (for example combat-party-crested-dwarf-ready.png, which is combat:party:10:0), each with a -materials.png beside it giving the original material index of every pixel, as the 1600 existing poses have, so that the colours a player chooses recolour it. Add each key to "assets" in upgrades/manifest.json. The large icons (heads 64 to 77) are complete.
requests.asked: Found 2026-11-22 while fixing the icon editor's missing icons from game/: the owner's brief for that fix asks for a request naming exactly any icon state whose artwork key does not exist. Measured with loadUpgradeArt: of the 1792 keys the editor can reach (14 heads by 32 bodies by 2 poses by 2 sizes), these 192 are missing, and none other.

requests.file: a tool and npm script (yours to name), its number at the top of docs/ART-WORKLIST.md
requests.what: Before more one-off portrait fixes (#80): build the count of every place the game cycles picture members while it holds a prompt (scene position, block, members, order, holds, from the scripts and the game's own picture routine), with verified = a passing Chrome check from both data sources that the page paints them in that order at those holds. Print verified / total and R, name each unverified place, stay red while R > 0, and show the number here through npm run art:worklist. Issue #131.
requests.asked: The owner, 2026-11-22: "I want to understand why we missed the portrait work on the first pass. How did our art inventory not account for that? And what else are we still missing?"

Show fallbacks / distinct keys as art to draw, red while any is left. Issue #142; #140 and #141 are the first two.
